P_0x00653B: A soldier in <Earth Fed Army> Intelligence. Calm and sharp, somewhat mysterious, yet loyal at heart. Graduate of the <Aggressors>, who built the <TC-OS> base data; top-tier <Personal Trooper> pilot. Rank: Major.
P_0x0066BD: Advisor to the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. A Jigen-ryu sword master who helped develop the Grungust's blade and sword data. Teacher to Sanger and Brit. Strict on swordplay, easygoing else.
P_0x006810: Staff of <Mao Industries>, seconded to the <Earth Fed Army> <Aggressors> for support duties. Thoughtful and quiet, with psychic powers; helped build Mao's man-machine interface. Her hobby, yoga, makes her a bit feared for suggesting tough poses.
P_0x006A06: Princess of Lucent, a Fed region by the Mediterranean. Innocent and curious, acts on impulse. Close with Latooni; has a quiet crush on Raideus. Has precognition.
P_0x006B36: President of <Mao Industries>, maker of the <Personal Trooper>. Cool and rational. Influenced by her founder father, she once aimed to pilot herself, having served in the Fed's East Asia "PTX Team" special unit.
